senses.gloss: f. (v. בַּר I; = h. חוֹצֶלֶת, מַחֲצֶלֶת) reed-matting used for partitions, coverings &c. [Var. בּוּדְיָא, against Syr. בוריא a. best Mss., v. בַּד III.] Succ. 20ᵇ מסככין בב׳ Ms. M. 2 (ed. a. Ar. with ד, Ms. M. 1 בכ׳) you may cover the festive booth with matting.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 67b:8">B. Mets. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>תמרי דאבודיא</he> ed. (Ms. M. <he>דעל בורי׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) dates spread on mattings.

<cite ref="Eruvin 8a">Erub. 8ᵃ</cite> an alley <he>כריך ב׳</he> (with <cite ref="D00000"><he>ד</he></cite>, ed., Ms. M. with <cite ref="T00000"><he>ר</he></cite>) surrounded by a partition of matting.—

<cite ref="Eruvin 102a:16">Ib. 102ᵃ</cite> <he>זיל כרוך ב׳ וכ׳</he> go and fold the matting up (for the night), but leave a handbreadth of it spread.—Pl. <he>בּוּרְיָתָא</he>. Succ. l. c. Ms. M. <he>בוריתא</he> a. <he>ביריתא</he> (Ms. M. 2 <cite ref="B01286"><he>בריתא</he></cite>).
